assessments.reason: A larger escrow deposit ($360,000 vs $240,000) gives Seller more security if Buyer fails to close; it is returned only if "a closing condition fails without Buyer's breach".
assessments.quote: Buyer shall deposit $360,000 with the jointly selected escrow holder upon execution.

assessments.reason: The confidentiality paragraph is unchanged in text; it moved from Section 7 to Section 3. This has no substantive effect on Seller.
assessments.quote: Each party shall keep the other party's nonpublic business information confidential

assessments.reason: Buyer's closing condition narrows from all consents to only those for contracts over $50,000. This reduces Buyer's walk-away rights and increases closing certainty for Seller.
assessments.quote: receipt of contract assignment consents for contracts exceeding $50,000 in annual charges

assessments.reason: Longer survival of Seller's representations (eighteen to twenty-four months) extends Seller's exposure to indemnity claims.
assessments.quote: The representations survive for twenty-four months after closing.

counter.find: survive for twenty-four months after closing
counter.replace: survive for twelve months after closing

assessments.reason: Seller's aggregate indemnity cap falls from the full Purchase Price to 10% of it, sharply limiting Seller's maximum exposure.
assessments.quote: Seller's aggregate indemnity liability is capped at 10% of the Purchase Price.

assessments.reason: Doubling the free instruction hours from forty to eighty increases Seller's uncompensated post-closing burden.
assessments.quote: for up to eighty staff hours without additional charge

counter.find: up to eighty staff hours without additional charge
counter.replace: up to forty staff hours without additional charge
counter.effect: Restores the original limit on Seller's unpaid effort.

assessments.reason: Changing "after business hours" to "outside business hours" is a minor clarification. It slightly broadens the next-day rule but has no meaningful effect on either party.
assessments.quote: A notice received outside business hours is effective the next business day.

assessments.reason: Changing "treated as an original" to "deemed an original" is a stylistic change with no substantive effect.
